description: Get a transactional email by ID or slug, including subject, preview text, blocks, variables, and linked dashboard URLs. `emailPreset` reports the per-email Style > Format the same way get_sequence does per step (branded or minimal; null when the whole email is standalone raw HTML), so it can be compared against sequence steps and campaigns without rendering them - minimal suppresses the company logo at render time.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

idOrSlug.description: Transactional email ID or API slug, for example `welcome-email`.

name: get_transactional_email

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_transactional_email` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

transactional.description: The transactional email record returned by Sequenzy.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
